question: **Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word. **
solution:
The incorrectly spelt word is: **Abendance **

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The incorrect spelling "**Abendance**" should be corrected to "**Abundance**."
 
• The correct spelling contains the letter "**u**" after "**b**," not "**a**."
 
• **Abundance **refers to a large quantity or a plentiful supply of something. (किसी चीज़ की बड़ी मात्रा या प्रचुर आपूर्ति)
 
 
• **For example-** *She had an abundance of fresh vegetables from her garden, enough to share with her neighbours and still have plenty for herself.*
 
 
 
• It's used to describe a state of having more than enough of a particular thing, whether it's material possessions, resources, opportunities, or even emotions.

Therefore the correct answer is **option 4**. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Astute **means having or showing an ability to accurately assess situations or people and turn this to one's advantage. (स्थितियों या लोगों का सटीक आकलन करने और इसे अपने लाभ में बदलने की क्षमता होना या दिखाना)
 
• **Absolute **means not qualified or diminished in any way; total. (किसी भी तरह से योग्य या कमतर नहीं; कुल)
 
• **Abrupt **means sudden and unexpected. (अचानक और अप्रत्याशित)
